mapper.select: SELECT l.leave_id AS leaveId, l.emp_id AS empId, e.emp_name AS empName, l.leave_type AS leaveType, l.start_date AS startDate, l.end_date AS endDate, l.leave_reason AS leaveReason, l.approval_status AS approvalStatus FROM LEAVE l JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON l.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE l.emp_id = #{empId} AND l.start_date >= #{startDate} AND l.end_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY l.start_date DESC
SELECT total_granted_leave FROM LEAVE_POLICY WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
SELECT SUM(DATEDIFF(l.end_date, l.start_date) + 1) FROM LEAVE l WHERE l.emp_id = #{empId} AND l.approval_status = '승인'
